fix.item: Follow-up hotfix for sites that updated to an early 1.1.2 build before schema and Active index rebuild fixes were complete.
Consolidates galleries/index schema migration hardening and Active index rebuild fixes from late 1.1.2 builds.
Active index rebuild now indexes first-level folders on disk even when managed gallery rows cannot be created yet.
Improved Active directory path resolution with multiple filesystem candidates and clearer zero-result diagnostics.

note.item: Recommended update for all 1.1.2 installations, especially when Active index rebuild returns 0 galleries despite existing folders.
After update, run Rebuild Active Index once from Galleries Index.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

fix.item: Added installer migration for the missing galleries.description column on upgraded or reinstall-over-existing-table sites.
Fixed administrator Galleries view SQL error: Unknown column g.description in SELECT.
Hardened schema migration with preflight execution and fallback ALTER statements.
Fixed Active/Legacy index rebuild failures on sites with legacy galleries or index table schemas.

note.item: Hotfix release. No other functional changes.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Added packaged language packs for cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR, and zh-CN.

change.item: Administrator Dashboard rebuilt with Slider-style action cards for New Gallery, Galleries, and Options.
Galleries Index remains as a secondary action above the existing dashboard statistics and info panels.
Language generator uses Argos offline translation with strict printf placeholder protection.

note.item: Admin UI polish and translations. No database schema changes.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+

addition.item: Packaged language packs for el-GR, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, and pt-PT.
Gallery hub with Overview, Photos, and Settings tabs for active galleries.
Package-only GitHub update channel at repository root (pkg_devartgallery).

change.item: Administrator Galleries, Index, and Dashboard rebuilt to match DevArt Widgets responsive pattern.
Simplified Galleries list; path/shortcode/integration details moved into Overview.
Legacy galleries open read-only in the hub.
Module image limit default is 24; limit 0 applies a safety cap of 200 (max 500).
Content plugin hard-caps rendered images at 60 for large legacy folders.
Rate-limited on-demand thumbnail cache cleanup during frontend rendering.

fix.item: Security and ACL hardening for admin mutations, custom actions with core fallbacks, and path checks.
Enforced max_images_per_gallery on uploads and scan-existing imports.
Upload dimension and pixel-count validation.
Replaced GLOB_BRACE folder scans with portable Folder::files().
Admin pagination fixed with plain GET links; site SEF router for Gallery menu items.
Hardened legacy read-only enforcement when POST gallery_id is used without query context.
JED Checker language quoting; removed duplicate package language files.
Localized remaining raw English upload failure messages.
Replaced Factory::getDbo() in admin controllers with DatabaseDriver from the DI container.
Removed obsolete imagedestroy() calls; added declare(strict_types=1) to module and content plugin.

note.item: Public minor release after baseline 1.0.11. Intermediate local builds are not published separately.
Requires Joomla 6.0+ and PHP 8.3.0+
Install and update only through pkg_devartgallery.

fix.item: Fixed New Gallery model architecture by switching NewgalleryModel to Joomla AdminModel form workflow.
Fixed New Gallery save validation workflow.
Fixed Joomla toolbar Back/Cancel button by using adminForm-compatible markup and gallery.cancel task.
Added missing COM_DEVARTGALLERY_ALIAS language string.

addition.item: Added per-gallery thumbnail cache settings with default values from component Options.
Added frontend on-demand thumbnail generation for active and legacy galleries.
Added thumbnail creation during new gallery/photo uploads from the administrator.
Added versioned thumbnail folders per gallery and per thumbnail setting hash.
Added staged thumbnail cleanup settings for old cache versions.

change.item: Gallery grid images now use lightweight generated thumbnails when available, while popup/full image links continue to use the optimized original image.
Existing active and legacy galleries do not generate thumbnails during installation/update; thumbnails are created only when the gallery is requested.
Changing thumbnail settings for one gallery clears only that gallery thumbnail cache.

note.item: No mass thumbnail regeneration is performed during update.
Thumbnail cache path: media/com_devartgallery/thumbs/gallery-{id}/{settings-hash}/.
No redesign. No frontend shortcode, module, content plugin, editor button, or legacy indexing logic changes in the hotfix portion of this release.

fix.item: Fixed critical Joomla 6 administrator fatal error in New Gallery workflow caused by incorrect model architecture.
Fixed New Gallery model to use proper Joomla AdminModel form workflow.
Fixed broken gallery save workflow for newly created galleries.
Fixed broken administrator Back / Cancel toolbar behavior in New Gallery view.
Fixed missing administrator language string COM_DEVARTGALLERY_ALIAS.

change.item: Improved Joomla 6 administrator form compatibility for gallery creation workflow.
Improved production stability for administrator gallery management.
Improved reliability of New Gallery create/save operations.

note.item: Critical production hotfix release.
Recommended update for all DevArt Gallery v1.0.9 installations.
No frontend behavior changes or feature modifications in this release.

fix.item: Fixed component configuration parameter handling when Joomla stores component params in nested JSON format.
Fixed Dashboard showing fallback or incorrect gallery paths instead of configured values.
Fixed Legacy Archive Directory display inconsistencies in the administrator dashboard.
Fixed Active Gallery Directory display inconsistencies in the administrator dashboard.
Fixed Legacy Index rebuild using incorrect directory values in specific installations.
Fixed Active Index rebuild using incorrect directory values in specific installations.
Fixed indexing behavior when configuration values were correctly saved but incorrectly read by internal component logic.
Fixed component options path handling for Legacy Archive Directory.
Fixed component options path handling for Active Gallery Directory.
Fixed legacy index rebuild using incorrect base directory when custom path was configured.
Fixed active gallery operations using fallback paths in some workflows.

change.item: Improved compatibility with different Joomla component parameter storage behaviors.
Improved dashboard configuration accuracy across installations.
Improved gallery indexing reliability for production environments.
Improved migration safety for legacy gallery deployments.
Improved internal configuration loading consistency.
Improved path consistency across Dashboard, Galleries, New Gallery, Manage Photos, Scan Existing Photos, delete safety checks and frontend shortcode resolving.

note.item: This release focuses on configuration reliability, indexing stability and production consistency.
Recommended update for all previous DevArt Gallery releases.

First production release for Joomla 6 with active managed galleries, legacy gallery indexing, content plugin, editor button plugin, frontend module, popup viewer, strict filename policy, ACL and Keep Data on Uninstall option.

fix.item: Fixed Legacy Archive Directory custom path handling when changed from default values.
Fixed Active Gallery Directory custom path handling when changed from default values.
Fixed dashboard directory cards showing incorrect default paths after configuration changes.
Fixed Legacy Index rebuild ignoring custom Legacy Archive Directory settings.
Fixed Active Index rebuild ignoring custom Active Gallery Directory settings.
Fixed legacy indexing conflicts when Legacy Archive Directory includes the Active Gallery Directory.

change.item: Improved path normalization and component parameter loading consistency.
Improved migration safety when legacy galleries are indexed from broader directories.
Improved dashboard accuracy for custom gallery path deployments.
Improved Joomla Update metadata consistency for production releases.

note.item: This release focused on custom path handling, indexing reliability and migration safety.
Recommended update for users of earlier initial releases.

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Image Gallery component with modern MVC architecture.
Added active managed gallery system.
Added legacy gallery indexing with read-only compatibility support.
Added portable path-based shortcode support for legacy and active galleries.
Added frontend gallery display module.
Added content plugin for article gallery rendering.
Added editor button for easy gallery shortcode insertion.
Added popup image viewer support.
Added responsive frontend gallery layouts.
Added Normal Grid and Masonry frontend display modes.
Added gallery management interface.
Added Manage Photos interface with pagination.
Added Scan Existing Photos support.
Added automatic image indexing system.
Added support for JPG, PNG and WEBP image uploads.
Added automatic image optimization workflow.
Added strict filename sanitization policy.
Added optional watermark support per gallery.
Added Joomla menu item integration for direct gallery frontend pages.
Added Joomla ACL permissions support.
Added Keep Data on Uninstall option.
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support.

change.item: Gallery architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+.
Legacy gallery compatibility implemented without modifying historical gallery folders.
Frontend rendering kept lightweight to minimize template conflicts.
CSS and JavaScript namespaced for safer third-party compatibility.
Manage Photos optimized with pagination for larger galleries.
Gallery indexing optimized for controlled batch operations.
Modern service provider and MVCComponent architecture used throughout.

note.item: Initial public release of DevArt Gallery for Joomla 6.
Designed for editorial, news and high-traffic Joomla websites.
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment.
